name: PERIPHERAL (BETA)
desc:
You are not alone in these halls.

Wake up in an abandoned facility that changes every match. Restore the power, find the key, memorize the code and escape before it finds you.

A single creature lives here. It doesn't chase you all the time. It watches, waits and picks the right moment. Look back and it retreats. Stare too long and it loses its patience.

HOW IT WORKS
- Procedural map: every match is a different maze
- Find fuses and restart all 3 generators
- Bad fuses and sloppy repairs make the power fail sooner
- Hide, hold your breath and stay quiet
- When the last generator turns on, the lights go red and the hunt begins

TIPS
- Light is your best ally. Watch your flashlight battery.
- Being alone is dangerous. Being in a group guarantees nothing.
- The code is not saved anywhere. Remember it.

Play with friends in public or private rooms. You have 3 lives.

Cloversky Studios
This game is in beta testing; errors may occur and updates may be frequent
